Four Gati Shakti Cargo Terminals Inaugurated in Gujarat

Four Gati Shakti Cargo Terminals have been inaugurated in Gujarat, aimed at boosting rail connectivity and cargo movement. The initiative is part of the Gati Shakti Master Plan, designed to improve multimodal logistics infrastructure across the country. The new terminals are expected to enhance efficiency and reduce logistics costs for businesses operating in the region. This development signifies a push towards modernizing India's freight transportation network.
